execution_boundary: No Docker command, HTTP request, Kafka action, database, volume, credential, or existing model artifact was used.
The model and threshold came from the isolated reproduced artifact; the forest was set to one in-memory worker for prediction only.
The test interval was not used to select the threshold or retrain the model.

input.resampling: stratified within observed normal and abnormal held-out test classes

interpretation: Intervals describe sampling uncertainty conditional on the supplied held-out CSV, fixed feature pipeline, fixed threshold, and fixed model artifact.
They do not resolve undocumented data provenance, label provenance, causal availability of Avg_Past_Consumption, or real-household generalization.
